label: LEAK_KINDS_v1
what: A taxonomy of LEAKS, read off the BEFORE-board, with one prescription per kind. The five-transformation catalogue labels the AFTER-board and scored kappa = 0.048 with three raters giving three labels to the founding case. A leak is visible before any transformation exists, which is what a finder needs.
assignment_caveat: Assigned by one instance (this session) from the `leak` field of proof-protocol/p1-retrodiction/cases/*/before.json, verbatim where possible. The after-boards were already known to me, so the fit in `matched` is a FIT, NOT A TEST. The test is a blind assignment by a rater who has not seen the after-boards, scored with the D20 instrument.

ACCUMULATION.signature: the loss equals (number of rounds or items) x (per-step cost). The invariant degrades a fixed amount per application of the move.
ACCUMULATION.prescription: find a functional the move CONSERVES, or replace the round structure by a procedure that acts at all scales simultaneously.
ACCUMULATION.exemplars_outside_the_corpus: K1 -> K3: Banaszczyk's Gaussian measure degrades per move and gives sqrt(log n); Guo-Fang-Lu's directional total variation is preserved EXACTLY under the same move and gives O(1). K2: Bansal-Jiang replace per-round existence by a diffusion whose legal-move existence is itself a theorem.

SATURATION.signature: the invariant caps at a value independent of the parameter you are trying to push. More of the same input cannot help.
SATURATION.prescription: the board has to be left. Look for a sourced statement of where the cap is -- the ceiling register -- and for the level at which the cap sits, because the cap may be liftable one level down instead.
SATURATION.exemplars_outside_the_corpus: GPY: rho_k(F) saturates at 4 for every k, so the criterion caps at 2*theta. Maynard-Tao left the sieve board; Zhang lifted the input a level down.

WRONG_STATISTIC.signature: the invariant measures a quantity that is not the one being bounded -- a mean where a maximum is wanted, a relaxation that cannot see the obstruction, a law that is simply false.
WRONG_STATISTIC.prescription: look for a certificate that sees the right quantity, and expect it to come from another field. This is the kind with the least guidance and the biggest jumps.

items.leak_quote: Counting controls the mean degree, not the maximum.
items.prescribed: a certificate that sees the maximum
items.actual: signed adjacency with A^2 = nI; lambda_1 <= Delta bounds the MAXIMUM degree

items.leak_quote: The per-step gain delta^2 against the additive cost of one dimension per step forces delta >~ 1/n.
items.prescribed: conserve, or act at all scales at once
items.actual: one-shot slice rank with NO iteration -- the accumulation is removed entirely

items.leak_quote: The linear program sees only cliques ... Its product law is correct; its value is wrong.
items.prescribed: a certificate that sees the right quantity
items.actual: the theta function via orthonormal representations

items.leak_quote: The factor n in tr exp gives log n. It is tight on direct sums of independent blocks.
items.prescribed: conserve, or act at all scales at once
items.actual: interlacing families: the largest root of a direct sum is the MAXIMUM over blocks, so the bound stops accumulating and becomes dimension-free

items.leak_quote: Cauchy-Schwarz sees pairwise line interactions only, which caps the exponent near n/2.
items.actual: the polynomial method -- a different board entirely

items.leak_quote: Circle incidence bounds are weaker than line incidence bounds.
items.prescribed: a certificate that sees the right quantity
items.actual: Elekes-Sharir lift turns distances into LINE incidences, then polynomial partitioning

items.leak_quote: The ratio saturates at 2*theta*(1+o(1)) regardless of k.
items.prescribed: leave the board, or lift the cap a level down
items.actual: BOTH happened, by two teams in one year: Maynard-Tao enlarged the move space (left the board), Zhang raised the level of distribution (lifted the input)

items.leak_quote: The sqrt(log n) comes from the union bound over sets.
items.prescribed: conserve, or act at all scales at once
items.actual: entropy / partial colouring -- the per-set union bound is replaced by a global entropy count

items.leak_quote: Each iteration recovers a fixed fraction of the defect, so about log k rounds are needed.
items.prescribed: conserve, or act at all scales at once
items.actual: efficient congruencing maintains congruence conditions at every scale SIMULTANEOUSLY, removing the accumulation over rounds

items.leak_quote: Game value is not multiplicative. Provers correlate across coordinates.
items.prescribed: a certificate that sees the right quantity
items.actual: information-theoretic embedding with per-coordinate relative entropy

items.leak_quote: Counting cannot see the obstruction, which is qualitative.
items.prescribed: a certificate that sees the right quantity, probably from another field
items.actual: the neighbourhood complex with Borsuk-Ulam -- topology

items.leak_quote: There is no control on collapsing at singular times.
items.prescribed: a certificate that sees the right quantity
items.actual: W-entropy and reduced volume give kappa-noncollapsing -- new monotone invariants on the SAME move

items.leak_quote: Size is multiplicative in the exponent under product.
items.prescribed: conserve, or act at all scales at once
items.actual: graph powering plus alphabet reduction with CONSTANT-factor blow-up -- the exponential accumulation is removed
